title: The interplay between developmental stage and environment underlies the adaptive effect of a natural transposable element insertion
one_liner_zh: 该文研究转座子插入对转录因子Lime表达及冷/免疫应激适应性的影响，属纯实验表型与表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Establishing causal links between adaptive mutations and their ecologically relevant phenotypes is key to understanding the process of adaptation, a central goal in evolutionary biology that is also relevant for conservation biology, medicine and agriculture. Although progress has been made, the number of causal adaptive mutations identified so far is still limited as gene by gene, and gene by environment interactions, among others, complicates linking genetic variation with its fitness–related effects. Transposable elements, often ignored in the quest for the genetic basis of adaptive evolution, are known to be a genome-wide source of regulatory elements across organisms that at times can lead to adaptive phenotypes. In this work, we combine gene expression, in vivo reporter assays, CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing, and survival experiments to characterize in detail the molecular and phenotypic consequences of a natural Drosophila melanogaster transposable element insertion: the roo solo-LTR FBti0019985 . This transposable element provides an alternative promoter to the transcription factor Lime , involved in cold- and immune-stress responses. We found that the effect of FBti0019985 on Lime expression depends on the interplay between the developmental stage and the environmental conditions. We further establish a causal link between the presence of FBti0019985 and increased survival to cold- and immune-stress. Our results exemplify how several developmental stages and environmental conditions need to be considered to characterize the molecular and functional effects of a genetic variant, and add to the growing body of evidence that transposable elements can induce complex mutations with ecologically relevant effects.
abstract_zh:
摘要

在适应性突变与其生态相关表型之间建立因果联系，是理解适应过程的关键，这也是进化生物学的一个核心目标，同时与保护生物学、医学和农业相关。尽管已取得进展，但迄今鉴定出的因果适应性突变数量仍然有限，因为基因与基因、基因与环境之间的相互作用等因素，使遗传变异与其适应性相关效应之间的关联变得复杂。转座子（transposable elements）在适应性进化的遗传基础探索中常被忽视，但已知它们是生物体中全基因组范围的调控元件来源，有时可导致适应性表型。在本研究中，我们结合基因表达、体内报告基因检测、CRISPR/Cas9基因组编辑和生存实验，详细表征了果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）中一个天然转座子插入——roo solo-LTR FBti0019985——的分子和表型后果。该转座子为转录因子Lime提供了替代启动子，Lime参与冷应激和免疫应激反应。我们发现，FBti0019985对Lime表达的影响取决于发育阶段与环境条件之间的相互作用。我们进一步建立了FBti0019985的存在与冷应激和免疫应激下生存率提高之间的因果联系。我们的结果例证了，要表征一个遗传变异的分子和功能效应，需要考虑多个发育阶段和环境条件，并增加了转座子可诱导具有生态相关效应的复杂突变的日益增多的证据。
